from itertools import product

Hidx=next(n.GetIdx() for n in m.GetAtomWithIdx(Cidx).GetNeighbors() if n.GetSymbol()=='H')

    p=xyz[Pidx]; c=xyz[Cidx]; dvec=c-p; D=np.linalg.norm(dvec)

    # normal using backbone geometry: P-C axis cross central aryl plane normal
    # choose both possibilities then score directionality
    nbrC=[n.GetIdx() for n in m.GetAtomWithIdx(Cidx).GetNeighbors() if n.GetSymbol()=='C']
    # radial direction out from aryl ring at target carbon
    outward=c-(xyz[nbrC[0]]+xyz[nbrC[1]])/2
    outward-=outward.dot(e)*e
    if np.linalg.norm(outward)>1e-6: outward/=np.linalg.norm(outward)

        pp=(ir-p); pp/=np.linalg.norm(pp)

        # favor low energy slightly and direction alignment
        total=score - 0.002*energy
        if best is None or total>best[0]: best=(total,seed,sign,D,energy,xyz.copy(),ir.copy(),outward.copy(),lp.copy(),score,md)

# Re-embed chosen seed and optimize to get same conformer (xyz retained)
# Remove target H
keep=[i for i in range(m.GetNumAtoms()) if i!=Hidx]

def norm(v): return v/np.linalg.norm(v)

hyd_i=len(atomlist)-2
